capabilities: Import a GitHub awesome or best-of list as a view note and an entries note
Compute an ok, caution, check or unknown verdict per repository from documented rules
Fetch published security advisories with severity and version ranges
Track star additions and local net star change over time
Sync vault edits with changes in the source list, accepting or dismissing each change
disambiguation: Not a to-do or checklist manager; it imports curated GitHub project lists into table notes in the vault.
extras: The GitHub token is stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault and the README warns not to share that file. The verdict is described as a review aid, not a security guarantee. Without a token, runs are limited to about 55 requests against GitHub's anonymous limits. Full reference documentation lives outside the README.
problem: Curated GitHub lists give no signal about which projects are maintained, deprecated or insecure, and checking each repository by hand is slow.

relations.evidence: The entries note keeps every value in inline fields that Dataview can read.
GitHub Stars | Repository links in your own notes | Those links | Star counts
GitHub Stars Manager | The repositories you starred | Your star list
Import GitHub Readme | One README | One file | The README text
GitHub Repo Tools | A local clone of one repository | One repository
GitHub Embeds | An issue, a pull request or a code snippet

summary: Turns a GitHub awesome or best-of list into a sortable table note with verdicts, security advisories and star history for each repository.
